question: Dr. Teejan Bai, who was awarded by Padma Vibhushan (2019) is a renowned Indian folk singer and performer from the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. Teejan Bai is a renowned Indian folk singer and performer from the state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2019, which is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• Dr. Teejan Bai is known for her Pandavani, a traditional performing art form that depicts the stories of the Mahabharata.
 
• Her contributions to Indian folk music and culture have been widely recognized both nationally and internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by Government servants.
 
• Dr. Teejan Bai has also been honored with other prestigious awards such as the Padma Shri (1988) and Padma Bhushan (2003).
 
• Her performances have played a significant role in popularizing the traditional art form of Pandavani across the globe.
 
• Dr. Teejan Bai's life and work continue to inspire many young artists in the field of Indian folk music and performing arts.
